title: [master][Subscription Billing] Sales-Explode BOM fails for foreign-currency customers
summary: Fixed a 'Sales Line does not exist' error when exploding an Assembly BOM on a sales order for a foreign-currency customer. GetDate() in the Sales Subscription Line table now reuses the cached in-memory Sales Line via GetSalesLine before falling back to a database lookup.
key_points: Exploding BOMs on foreign-currency sales orders raised 'Sales Line does not exist' error
Root cause was direct database lookup of Sales Line during BOM explosion when the line only existed in memory
Changed GetDate() to use GetSalesLine() method to leverage cached Sales Line before fallback database lookup
Added test coverage for the foreign-currency BOM explosion scenario
Affects Subscription Billing feature in sales order processing
